Overview

8 AIMO 2 reference problems (val-sample) × 8 perturbation types × 5 variants (first 5 accepted after manual review), T=1.0, top-k 40, top-p 0.95, max 32,768 generated tokens. A sample is correct if its last ANSWER: matches the reference (mod 1000) or is NaN for expert_no_solution; samples that hit the token cap count as wrong.

Traces side by side

Pick a problem, perturbation type and variant. The perturbed question is diffed against the original (added, removed). Each column shows one model's samples: click a sample to open its reasoning; the viewer keeps the first 3,000 and last 3,000 characters of each trace.

Generated by experiments/val_perturb/viewer.py from runs/ (vLLM, T=1.0, top-k 40, top-p 0.95, 32,768-token cap, 5 samples per prompt). Perturbations were generated with gpt-5.2 and manually reviewed; dropped variants are excluded, flagged ones marked. A NaN answer counts as correct only for expert_no_solution prompts. Truncated samples count as wrong, so accuracy on long-winded models is a lower bound. Traces are abbreviated to their first and last 3,000 characters; full text lives in runs/*.part*.gz.
